# P22 — Sequential workflow engine

Status: **blocked_external**. Independent domain/API implementation and named local P22_A1–A3 checks delivered; real provider/authority/privacy/human gates remain below. P23 reviewer inbox is not implemented.

## Delivered contracts and review

Migration030 extends the existing request/workflow spine;63tables/714columns/86public functions. New approval_assignments, append-only approval_decisions, fixed request_workflow_outcomes and immutable request_workflow_events have RLS enabled and no raw authenticated/anonymous/service-role access. Explicit same-term deployed service review roles, current core roster/workspace access, active role/version/expiry and requester independence govern every command. Configuration labels confer no protected authority.

activate_request_workflow is an explicit non-requester current service-head command. It activates configured named one/all slots or replaces missing/revoked authority with a new immutable generation. Reassignment preserves the original all-reviewer slot count and invalidates prior-generation quorum. Missing authority/documents/entry conditions/routing produces an auditable paused receipt; malformed commands fail without false success. review:none and a final pending stage remain fail-closed configuration pauses. Conditions use the existing fixed bounded operators; no script evaluation or silent stage skipping.

transition_request derives its actor from session identity, locks the work/current instance and current reviewer authority rows, checks exact stage/revision/version and appends one immutable decision per assignment. All votes are required for an all stage; one stage requires its one assigned reviewer. Explicit reject/request_revision acts immediately; configured approved revision routing waits for the full approve quorum. Each successor stage pauses for explicit authorized assignment. Revision resubmission follows the pinned revisionStage with a new immutable revision/instance; old evidence remains. General approved/rejected/completed/needs_revision outcomes, business state, decision, workflow event, redacted audit, idempotency receipt and outbox commit together. Expected versions plus exact actor/key/payload retry prevent double voting; revoked actors cannot replay old receipts.

Only general services without protected/finance bindings or currency fields can activate. FIN/MCD and finance-bearing forms remain typed_authority_module_pending until their typed modules exist. Stage labels never grant clearance, accept a deliverable/deadline, or authorize spending/publicity. The pre-existing requester can revise paused/needs_revision cases, cancel pending cases and see fixed next actions; terminal results cannot be cancelled into a draft.

read_request_workflow independently authorizes owner/current scoped manager/eligible prior participant metadata. Only requester or currently assigned exact-stage reviewer obtains the immutable package. Manager status alone does not expose private title/body/files. Reasons are filtered, origin work access is not granted, and current authority is rechecked per exact selected revision-manifest asset through the existing P12/P17 download/Edge seam, before and after bytes. Unselected assets and common requester detail remain closed to reviewers. API is src/features/approvals/api.ts, wired into the existing auth gateway; malformed mutation responses are uncertain failures with exact retry, never fake success. No automatic retries or raw private browser persistence.

Simulated product/security/skeptical council review used one assistant, not independent agents. Explicit scoped assignment was chosen over broad work grants; stale authority pauses rather than silently weakening quorum. Fixed outcomes keep institutional authority separate from configured labels. Serial local testing supports implementation but cannot prove actual concurrent sessions. All inherited activation gates remain. No agents/chats/worktrees, deployment/provider/billing/cap/reset-credit changes or external messages.
